title: What this course asked of parents
intro: HEDGE™ is an invented course for parents. Its reasons are not: each one was taught by a real ministry, newsletter, book, web page or campaign between 1988 and 2026, and some of them were first taught about gay people. This is what that teaching said and asked, in its own words where it can be quoted, with what is known beside it.

sections.heading: It said nobody knew the cause, then listed causes

items.text: A ministry newsletter admitted it in 2019: “Aside from living in a fallen world, no one is certain what causes gender confusion.” Its next three pages list causes anyway: the family, not fitting in with other children, trauma, mental health, a teenager’s experiments, friends, and social media.
items.source: Reconciliation Ministries of Michigan, "The Building Blocks of Gender Confusion" (newsletter article), © 2019, p. 1 (the admission) and pp. 2–4 (the causes it then lists), recmin.org newsletter, read on the page images

items.text: It began with the family. In 1988 a telephone counselling manual traced a caller’s “false identity” to hurt, and told callers to forgive “those who have hurt them (usually family members)”.
items.source: Exodus International North America, Exodus Telephone Counseling Manual, © 1988, "Transsexuality" tab, printed pp. 46–47 (PDF pp. 50–51); Smithsonian NMAH.AC.1428, Box 2, Folder 10 — read on the page images

items.text: Then her friends. The 2019 newsletter: “one person in a social group coming out as transgender prompts many more in that social group to come out as transgender. … This is called rapid-onset gender dysphoria.”
items.source: Reconciliation Ministries of Michigan, "The Building Blocks of Gender Confusion" (newsletter article), © 2019, p. 1 (the admission) and pp. 2–4 (the causes it then lists), recmin.org newsletter, read on the page images (p. 4)

items.text: Then the whole culture. A church paper in 2021: “Most of what people are taught today comes through public education, popular culture, and social media.” A ministry in 2025: “a culture that has been swept up by gender ideology”.
items.source: ICCEC U.S. Theological Commission, 'Sexual Brokenness and Gender Issues' (Human Sexuality Addendum 1), 2021, p. 4 — read on the page image; Love & Truth Network, '18 - Responding to Family Members Who Have Embraced Gender Ideology', blog post dated 31 Oct 2025 — narrow-way.loveandtruthnetwork.com/post/responding-to-family-members-who-have-embraced-gender-ideology (read 15 Nov 2026)

items.text: Nothing was dropped; each reason was added to the ones before. The 1988 manual’s “a false identity” is the 2025 post’s “a new, false gender identity”, and the 2019 newsletter keeps the family roots (pp. 2–3) beside “social contagion” (p. 4).
items.source: Exodus International North America, Exodus Telephone Counseling Manual, © 1988, "Transsexuality" tab, printed pp. 46–47 (PDF pp. 50–51); Smithsonian NMAH.AC.1428, Box 2, Folder 10 — read on the page images; Love & Truth Network, '18 - Responding to Family Members Who Have Embraced Gender Ideology', blog post dated 31 Oct 2025 — narrow-way.loveandtruthnetwork.com/post/responding-to-family-members-who-have-embraced-gender-ideology (read 15 Nov 2026); Reconciliation Ministries of Michigan, "The Building Blocks of Gender Confusion" (newsletter article), © 2019, p. 1 (the admission) and pp. 2–4 (the causes it then lists), recmin.org newsletter, read on the page images

items.text: To look for the wound in themselves: a 2002 parents’ booklet recommended a book in which “Compassion also takes responsibility for one’s parental contributions to the child’s pain”.
items.source: Focus on the Family, When a Loved One Says 'I'm Gay' (Love Won Out series), © 2002, resources pp. 42–43 (PDF p. 24), two book blurbs; Smithsonian NMAH.AC.1428, Box 8, Folder 5 — read on the page image

items.text: To watch for signs: “Are you afraid your child may be struggling with gender identity or otherwise heading in a wrong direction?” The same booklet promised “the skills to prevent a life of heartbreak”. In 2003 Exodus told churches to watch for “a young girl in our Sunday School classes that might have some gender identity deficits”.
items.source: Focus on the Family, When a Loved One Says 'I'm Gay' (Love Won Out series), © 2002, resources pp. 42–43 (PDF p. 24), two book blurbs; Smithsonian NMAH.AC.1428, Box 8, Folder 5 — read on the page image; The Christian Post, 5 Aug 2003, quoting Exodus's board chair on the July 2003 assembly — christianpost.com/news/exodus-ministries-plans-for-direct-assistance-to-147-heal-and-prevent-148-homosexuality.html (read 15 Nov 2026 by job 26)

items.text: To watch her phone: “If your children have unmonitored access to the Internet, you are a negligent parent.” The book’s author has software on his children’s phones: “I know how many times they text.”
items.source: ERLC (the Southern Baptist Convention's Ethics & Religious Liberty Commission), Sexual Brokenness and the Hope of the Gospel, © 2014, pp. 108 and 127 — read on the page images

items.text: To have her prayed for by strangers, by name: a parents’ prayer list promises that each child added will be “prayed for by all the members at least once a day”.
items.source: Sorrowful Hearts, 'Parents' page (first archived Dec 2013, live) — sorrowfulhearts.com/parents.html (read 15 Nov 2026)

items.text: Before 18, pressure; after 18, patience: “Those under 18 can involve a full-court press approach, while young adults will have the liberty to make their own choices.” And: “It can take 7-10 years for individuals to work through the implications…”
items.source: Love & Truth Network, '18 - Responding to Family Members Who Have Embraced Gender Ideology', blog post dated 31 Oct 2025 — narrow-way.loveandtruthnetwork.com/post/responding-to-family-members-who-have-embraced-gender-ideology (read 15 Nov 2026)

items.text: To talk to the ministry’s machine first: its AI page offers that you can “easily connect with a human for FREE”.
items.source: Love & Truth Network, AI Assistant page, printed 14 Nov 2026 — loveandtruthnetwork.com/ai, p. 1 of the printout (read on the page image); free coaching '40 minutes' (/free-coaching) and '1 hour' (/friends-and-family), read 15 Nov 2026

items.text: It told the threat as history: a 2016 opinion piece was titled “Why We Should Have Seen The Transgender Craze Coming” (“Craze” is its own word), and said it “arrived decades ago as a tiny seed”.
items.source: The Federalist, 28 Nov 2016, 'Why We Should Have Seen The Transgender Craze Coming' (opinion) — thefederalist.com/2016/11/28/seen-transgender-craze-coming/ (read 15 Nov 2026 by job 26)

items.text: Parenthood became a political identity. A 2026 report on anti-gender movements: religious and populist movements “have strategically and deliberately elevated parenthood as a political identity and the child as a sacred figure around which coalitions can be built”.
items.source: Transnational Institute, State of Power 2026, chapter 9 ("The Innocent Children"), printed p. 83 (PDF p. 4) — read on the page image

items.text: Its word reached governments. A UN expert wrote in 2021 that “gender ideology” is “a linguistic formula used symbolically to refer in an accusatory manner”, that it began in opposition to the Cairo (1994) and Beijing (1995) conferences, and that state and diplomatic actors were already using its narratives. In 2025 a government put the phrase in the title of an executive order.
items.source: UN Independent Expert on sexual orientation and gender identity, report A/76/152, 15 Jul 2021, pp. 4–5, paras 9–11 — United Nations document A/76/152 (read on the page images); Executive Order 14168 of 20 Jan 2025, its title ("Defending Women From Gender Ideology Extremism and Restoring Biological Truth to the Federal Government"), 90 FR 8615 — govinfo.gov/content/pkg/FR-2025-01-30/html/2025-02090.htm (read 15 Nov 2026 by job 26)

items.text: And into election advertising: a 2026 campaign ad closed with “If you care about your children, …”.
items.source: Associated Press, 28 Oct 2026 (via News4JAX): a 2026 campaign ad's closing line — news4jax.com/news/politics/2026/10/28/republicans-emphasize-transgender-ads-putting-cultural-issues-over-voters-economic-anxiety/ (read 15 Nov 2026 by job 26)

items.text: Homosexuality left the American Psychiatric Association’s manual in 1973 and the WHO’s in 1990.
items.source: 'Out of DSM: Depathologizing Homosexuality', Behavioral Sciences 5(4), 2015, pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4695779/ (the American Psychiatric Association's Board vote, Dec 1973; in 1990 the WHO removed homosexuality per se from the ICD) — read 15 Nov 2026; WHO ICD-10 F66: 'Sexual orientation by itself is not to be regarded as a disorder' — icd.who.int/browse10/2019/en (read 15 Nov 2026)

items.text: DSM-5 (2013): “gender non-conformity is not in itself a mental disorder”.
items.source: American Psychiatric Association, 'Gender Dysphoria Diagnosis' (Nov 2017): 'With the publication of DSM–5 in 2013, "gender identity disorder" was eliminated and replaced with "gender dysphoria"'; 'gender non-conformity is not in itself a mental disorder' — psychiatry.org/Psychiatrists/Diversity/Education/Transgender-and-Gender-Nonconforming-Patients/Gender-Dysphoria-Diagnosis (read 15 Nov 2026)

items.text: In June 2013 Exodus International, whose 1988 manual opens this tape, shut down, and its president apologised.
items.source: RNS in The Christian Century, issue of 24 July 2013 ('announced June 19 that it was shutting its doors'; a statement 'apologizing to the gay community') — christiancentury.org/article/2013-06/ex-gay-group-exodus-international-shuts-down-president-apologizes (read 15 Nov 2026)

items.text: “Rapid-onset gender dysphoria” “is not a diagnostic classification or subtype” in the DSM or the ICD, “nor is it under consideration for inclusion in future editions”.
items.source: CAAPS (Coalition for the Advancement & Application of Psychological Science), Position Statement on ROGD, published 26 Jul 2021; signatories include the American Psychological Association and the American Psychiatric Association — caaps.co/rogd-statement (read 15 Nov 2026)

items.text: ICD-11, in force since 1 January 2022, moved gender incongruence out of the chapter of mental disorders. The WHO: “trans-related and gender diverse identities are not conditions of mental ill-health”.
items.source: WHO, 'Gender incongruence and transgender health in the ICD' (FAQ) — who.int/standards/classifications/frequently-asked-questions/gender-incongruence-and-transgender-health-in-the-icd; WHO news, 11 Feb 2022 (read 15 Nov 2026 by job 26)
